mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username} AND status='active'

SELECT d.document_id, d.title, d.original_filename, d.content_type, d.file_size, d.visible_roles, d.uploader_username, d.create_time, COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS chunk_count FROM ai_knowledge_document d LEFT JOIN ai_knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id=d.document_id WHERE d.deleted=0 GROUP BY d.document_id ORDER BY d.document_id DESC
SELECT document_id, title, object_name, visible_roles FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND deleted=0

SELECT c.chunk_id, d.document_id, d.title, c.chunk_no, c.page_start, c.page_end, c.chunk_text FROM ai_knowledge_document d JOIN ai_knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id=d.document_id WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.status='READY' AND (d.visible_roles='ALL'
OR (
FIND_IN_SET(#{role}, d.visible_roles) > 0
) ) ORDER BY c.chunk_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.chunk_id, d.document_id, d.title, c.chunk_no, c.page_start, c.page_end, c.chunk_text FROM ai_knowledge_document d JOIN ai_knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id=d.document_id WHERE d.document_id=#{documentId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.status='READY' ORDER BY c.chunk_no ASC

SELECT c.chunk_id, d.document_id, d.title, c.chunk_no, c.page_start, c.page_end, c.chunk_text FROM ai_knowledge_document d JOIN ai_knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id=d.document_id WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.status='READY' ORDER BY d.document_id ASC, c.chunk_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_document (title, original_filename, object_name, content_type, file_size, visible_roles, uploader_id, uploader_username) VALUES (#{title}, #{originalFilename}, #{objectName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{visibleRoles}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderUsername})

INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (document_id, chunk_no, page_start, page_end, chunk_text) VALUES
(#{chunk.documentId}, #{chunk.chunkNo}, #{chunk.pageStart}, #{chunk.pageEnd}, #{chunk.chunkText})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET deleted=1 WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND deleted=0
